$comment: CAT-F real-to-floor rollback: a user explicitly rolls a real version back to the floor version. This is a package transaction like any other and TXN-1's quiescence proof applies to the currently-live real service before the floor (serviceless) tree is promoted in its place.

expected_outcome.action: TXN-1 quiescence proof required against the currently-running real service before promote (this is a live service, unlike the floor-to-real direction). Stop with the SVC-1 sequence, verify absence, then P1 promote proceeds normally. The rollback stays on the Primary root; retained user data (Syncthing/) is untouched per retained_roots.
expected_outcome.post_state: service.id org.umrk.syncthing no longer discoverable (no service object); persistent Start with Leaf enablement is cleared as part of the transaction's final database commit, matching an ordinary uninstall-of-service semantics even though the package id remains installed as the floor.
